en: Dependent on a mundane, non-visible, and non-reactive state, a mundane, visible, and reactive state arises by way of root condition … one.
Dependent on a supramundane, non-visible, and non-reactive state, a mundane, visible, and reactive state arises by way of root condition … one.
(These three questions should be counted by calculation. Abbreviated. Three for root, three for predominance … pe … three for non-disappearance.
Dependent on a mundane state that is non-visible and non-reacting, there arises a mundane [state] that is non-visible and non-reacting...
(Three questions are to be formulated. Abbreviated. Under root condition there are three; under predominance condition there are three... pe ... under mutuality condition there is one... pe ...
under non-disappearance condition there are three.

Dependent on a supramundane state that is non-demonstrable and non-reactive, a mundane state that is non-demonstrable and non-reactive arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there is one; under predominance condition there is one … pe … under non-disappearance condition there is one.
